title: launcher-recipe.json (LAUNCHER-FOLLOWS-GAME section 5.1)
description: How to build the game, as data: the toolchain floor, the CMake preset per OS, the configure options and when each applies, the code generation step, the targets. Checked in at the game repo root next to larecomp_manifest.toml; the launcher reads it after the Sources step. The launcher keeps launcher.* values (the CPU level choice, jobs) and supplies them by name; tool pins, URLs and hashes stay in the launcher (a download must not be steerable by the repo). A when is an expression over the facts the launcher has before the first probe (the l0 facts of fact-dictionary.json).

min_launcher.description: optional: the oldest LAUNCHER PROGRAM (the app the player runs; its own version is <major>.<days since 2026-01-01>.<minute of day>, like 1.332.480) that can set up and run this game version. A launcher whose version is lower must not build or update to this game version: it shows a 'this game version needs a newer launcher' screen and keeps the install it has. min_reader is the contract-format gate; this is the program gate (new setup actions, new launcher features the game relies on). Absent means no requirement; a launcher that cannot parse the value ignores it. The single source is min_launcher of launcher-recipe.json at the game repo root; the other contract files take the value from it.

sdk.description: SDK revision and prebuilt kit configuration for this game commit

toolchain.description: the floor the recipe needs: the launcher fails a setup whose pinned tool is below it, and says to update the launcher

presets.description: the CMake preset to configure with, per OS

place.description: Map from a codegen input name to the file's placement path, relative to the game source checkout

steps.description: extra build steps, in order, when the default configure + build is not all

options.description: configure options (-D<name>=<value>), each with the condition under which it applies

from.description: a value the launcher supplies by name (launcher.<name>), or kit:<id>: the checked archive of that archive kit of the kits file

only_if_defined.description: pass it only when the sources' CMake defines the option (an older game does not)
